title: Programmes are found through a registry
statement: Every reader and writer MUST find a programme's files through the registry, never by building a path from a run id.
why: Readers that built paths locked parity to ticket-shaped run ids.

acceptance.text: Given a programme registered under a key that is not a ticket id, when any backlog command runs with that key, then it reads and writes that programme's files.

falsifiedBy: A command that fails for a programme whose key is not a ticket id.

sources.quote: and no reader that constructs the path itself.
